text:
Alex R: Nightly probe finished — variant heatmap up at https://artifacts.redwood/probes/3401234567/heatmap.png :eyes:
Perfbot: CI job #1874 completed — microbench suite ran across ampere/h100/avx2. Summary: 3 regressions, 1 improvement.
Priya S: link looks noisy at seqlen 1024 — can we get the per-variant breakdown? the heatmap aggregates across batches.
Alex R: yeah, the aggregation hides path flips. Uploaded CSV + probe matrix at https://artifacts.redwood/probes/3401234567/matrix.csv
Maria K: quick note — the new kv-cache-friendly kernel (kv_opt_v3) shows perf win at <256 but drops at >2048 on h100.
Jordan L: that's the pattern i was worried about. heuristics currently pick kv_opt_v3 when avg_seq < 800. That threshold may be too high.
Priya S: can we run sensitivity sweep using probe flags? i ran a smoke with:
```
./run_probe --variants kv_opt_v3,kv_opt_v2,baseline --arch h100,ampere --seqlens 32,128,512,1024,2048 --batch_sizes 1,4,16
```
Alex R: thanks — kicked off nightly sweep (job id 3401234590). perfbot will post diffs.
Perfbot: sweep job 3401234590 started — artifact: https://artifacts.redwood/sweeps/3401234590/
Jordan L: if kv_opt_v3 fails tail we should consider fallback to kv_opt_v2 for sequences >1024 on h100 only.
Priya S: vote: conservative fallback rule + a gating CI that rejects candidate kernels if seqlen tail reg > 2% latency.
Alex R: agreed. Also adding autotune rule to prefer kv_opt_v2 for amps when mean_seq > 900.
Maria K: filing a perf-repro issue with logs and repro steps.
Alex R: tagging @oncall-eng-runtime for rollouts tomorrow. anyone object?
Jordan L: no objections. i'll draft the rollout change in the picklist PR.
Priya S: ping me when draft is up, i'll add the unit tests and sample probes. :thumbsup:
Perfbot: sweep job 3401234590 finished — diffs: kv_opt_v3: +2.8% p95 on h100 seqlen 2048, -6.5% p50 on ampere seqlen 128. artifact: https://artifacts.redwood/sweeps/3401234590/report.html
Alex R: ok we're blocking kv_opt_v3 for h100 tail. i'll update gating and PR.
Maria K: thanks all.
